The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider and the driver: this ruling concerns trip TRP-02827 (pickup Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd, dropoff Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4, 29 Aug 2026). DISTANCE AND DEVIATION (POL-RD-01). The governing measurement is the GPS trace. EV-GPS-02827 records trace_distance_km 14.4 against the booked optimal of 9.0 km on EV-TRIP-02827 — an excess of 5.4 km, which is 60.0% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (60.0% > 20% and 5.4 km > 0.8 km) and the excess also clears the 50% materiality gate, so a MATERIAL route deviation is established on this trip's own evidence. The trace itself is clean for policy purposes — 114 fixes at a 10 s interval, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, 100% coverage — so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is not met, no independent corroboration is required, and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. Both advocates' agreement on this point is accepted. NO ADJUSTMENT TO THE EXCESS. The chat log EV-CHAT-02827 contains 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction and POL-RD-04 is unavailable; the trip record shows null amendment timestamps and a null amended optimal, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's pooled baseline does not apply. The driver's explanation, 'Road works.', names no advisory evidence ID, and the bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02827-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cited no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) keeps this out of POL-RD-10(5): an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so the case does not escalate on that ground. I have weighed the driver's traffic excuse and rejected it as unsupported on this record; the excess stands at the measured 5.4 km / 60.0%. THE FARE ARITHMETIC. On the METERED model (quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply), POL-RD-02 computes recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 9.0 km + 0.28 x 13.0 min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from EV-FARE-02827, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 14.99. Charged_total is 20.66, giving a POL-RD-02 refund of 5.67, rounded UP to 5.70. Both advocates agree on this figure and it is correct; I record it as the base figure. THE REMEDY UPLIFT (POL-RD-06). The driver profile EV-DPROF-02827 shows deviation_flags_90d of 3 and completed_trips_90d of 180. The clause establishes a pattern when deviation_flags_90d is 3 or more OR the ratio is 0.05 or more with at least 40 completed trips. Three flags meets the first limb outright, so a repeat pattern is ESTABLISHED. I reject the driver advocate's argument that the 0.0167 ratio defeats the test: the clause's two limbs are alternatives, not cumulative, and the 'permissive' reading of limb (b) is not what the clause says — the three effects listed are what follow once the pattern is established. Because the deviation here is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own trace, POL-RD-06(b) upgrades the remedy from the POL-RD-02 partial to FULL_REFUND of charged_total. No ERP, toll or airport surcharge line exists to be settled separately under POL-RD-09 (tolls_erp 0.00, airport_surcharge 0.00, erp_gantries empty), so the whole charged_total is uplifted. Side by side: the POL-RD-02 figure is 5.70; the uplifted POL-RD-06(b) figure is 20.66. The uplift is a remedy uplift only — the finding of deviation rests on this trip's trace alone, not on the driver's history, and POL-GEN-01 is respected: only deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d were used, and prior_deviation_flags (5) is a lifetime counter that grounded nothing. OTHER LINES. EV-FARE-02827 itemises no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge, no cancellation fee and no fixed surcharges, and its lines reconcile to the 20.66 charged, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and no billing-integrity correction or referral arises. EV-RPROF-02827 shows deviation_claims_60d 0, so POL-RD-08's serial-claimant corroboration enhancement is not in play. OUTCOME. Full refund of the contested amount: SGD 20.66 to the rider (the POL-RD-02 base figure of SGD 5.70 is recorded above for audit). Under POL-RD-06(c) the case is additionally referred to driver-conduct review; that referral rides with the money and does not displace or delay it. Confidence is 0.90 — the cap is the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding facts, and EV-GPS-02827, EV-TRIP-02827, EV-FARE-02827 and EV-DPROF-02827 are each at weight 1.0. The monetary effect of SGD 20.66 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is issued but not executed automatically: the amount is held for release by a human reviewer. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

To the rider and the driver: this ruling concerns trip TRP-02827 (pickup Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd, dropoff Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4, 29 Aug 2026). DISTANCE AND DEVIATION (POL-RD-01). The governing measurement is the GPS trace. EV-GPS-02827 records trace_distance_km 14.4 against the booked optimal of 9.0 km on EV-TRIP-02827 — an excess of 5.4 km, which is 60.0% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (60.0% > 20% and 5.4 km > 0.8 km) and the excess also clears the 50% materiality gate, so a MATERIAL route deviation is established on this trip's own evidence. The trace itself is clean for policy purposes — 114 fixes at a 10 s interval, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, 100% coverage — so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is not met, no independent corroboration is required, and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. Both advocates' agreement on this point is accepted. NO ADJUSTMENT TO THE EXCESS. The chat log EV-CHAT-02827 contains 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction and POL-RD-04 is unavailable; the trip record shows null amendment timestamps and a null amended optimal, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's pooled baseline does not apply. The driver's explanation, 'Road works.', names no advisory evidence ID, and the bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02827-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cited no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) keeps this out of POL-RD-10(5): an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so the case does not escalate on that ground. I have weighed the driver's traffic excuse and rejected it as unsupported on this record; the excess stands at the measured 5.4 km / 60.0%. THE FARE ARITHMETIC. On the METERED model (quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply), POL-RD-02 computes recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 9.0 km + 0.28 x 13.0 min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from EV-FARE-02827, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 14.99. Charged_total is 20.66, giving a POL-RD-02 refund of 5.67, rounded UP to 5.70. Both advocates agree on this figure and it is correct; I record it as the base figure. THE REMEDY UPLIFT (POL-RD-06). The driver profile EV-DPROF-02827 shows deviation_flags_90d of 3 and completed_trips_90d of 180. The clause establishes a pattern when deviation_flags_90d is 3 or more OR the ratio is 0.05 or more with at least 40 completed trips. Three flags meets the first limb outright, so a repeat pattern is ESTABLISHED. I reject the driver advocate's argument that the 0.0167 ratio defeats the test: the clause's two limbs are alternatives, not cumulative, and the 'permissive' reading of limb (b) is not what the clause says — the three effects listed are what follow once the pattern is established. Because the deviation here is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own trace, POL-RD-06(b) upgrades the remedy from the POL-RD-02 partial to FULL_REFUND of charged_total. No ERP, toll or airport surcharge line exists to be settled separately under POL-RD-09 (tolls_erp 0.00, airport_surcharge 0.00, erp_gantries empty), so the whole charged_total is uplifted. Side by side: the POL-RD-02 figure is 5.70; the uplifted POL-RD-06(b) figure is 20.66. The uplift is a remedy uplift only — the finding of deviation rests on this trip's trace alone, not on the driver's history, and POL-GEN-01 is respected: only deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d were used, and prior_deviation_flags (5) is a lifetime counter that grounded nothing. OTHER LINES. EV-FARE-02827 itemises no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge, no cancellation fee and no fixed surcharges, and its lines reconcile to the 20.66 charged, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and no billing-integrity correction or referral arises. EV-RPROF-02827 shows deviation_claims_60d 0, so POL-RD-08's serial-claimant corroboration enhancement is not in play. OUTCOME. Full refund of the contested amount: SGD 20.66 to the rider (the POL-RD-02 base figure of SGD 5.70 is recorded above for audit). Under POL-RD-06(c) the case is additionally referred to driver-conduct review; that referral rides with the money and does not displace or delay it. Confidence is 0.90 — the cap is the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding facts, and EV-GPS-02827, EV-TRIP-02827, EV-FARE-02827 and EV-DPROF-02827 are each at weight 1.0. The monetary effect of SGD 20.66 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is issued but not executed automatically: the amount is held for release by a human reviewer. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.
To the rider and the driver. Trip TRP-02827 ran on 29 Aug 2026 from Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd to Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4. The platform's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02827) records the distance driven as 14.4 km against a booked optimal of 9.0 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02827). That is an excess of 5.4 km, or 60.0% of optimal. THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED. POL-RD-01 measures actual distance from the trace, not the receipt copy, and both tests pass: 5.4 km exceeds 0.8 km and 60.0% exceeds 20%. Above 50% it is also a MATERIAL deviation. The trace is sound for policy purposes: 114 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, maximum gap 0.0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a)–(c) is met, no independent corroboration is required and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. NOTHING EXCUSES THE EXCESS. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02827) holds no messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04; the amendment fields on EV-TRIP-02827 are all null, so no relocation re-bases the route under POL-RD-05; the vehicle is RYDE_X, so the pooled baseline under POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's explanation, 'Road works.', has no advisory behind it: the bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02827-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) — no advisory covers this corridor in this window. POL-RD-03 therefore cannot be run, and under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13(2) the assertion carries no weight and the deviation stands at the measured figure. Because the driver named no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) keeps this out of POL-RD-10(5), so the case does not escalate on that ground. THE MONEY. The driver's POL-RD-02 arithmetic is correct as far as it goes. charged_total: SGD 20.66 (EV-FARE-02827). recomputed_fare: SGD 14.99 — (3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.0 km + 0.28 x 13.0 min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, plus the 0.80 platform fee. POL-RD-02 refund: SGD 5.70 (20.66 - 14.99 = 5.67, rounded up to the nearest 0.05). But POL-RD-06 applies whenever POL-RD-01 records a MATERIAL deviation, and this one is material. The driver profile (EV-DPROF-02827) shows deviation_flags_90d = 3, which meets the clause's '3 or more' limb and ESTABLISHES a repeat-deviation pattern. The argument that the ratio limb fails (3/180 = 0.0167) does not help: the clause is disjunctive and either limb establishes the pattern, so the ratio is not required. Limb (b) then applies because this deviation is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own trace. Side by side, as the clause requires: under POL-RD-02 alone SGD 5.70; under the POL-RD-06(b) uplift SGD 20.66, the whole of charged_total. There are no pass-through lines to carve out — tolls/ERP 0.00, airport surcharge 0.00, itemised gantry list empty — so the full charged_total is refunded. The uplift changes the remedy, not the finding: the deviation is found on this trip's trace alone under POL-RD-01, and the history is used only as POL-RD-06 and POL-GEN-01 permit — deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only and grounded nothing. The rider's claim for the whole fare is granted, but not by the route first put forward: POL-RD-02 alone caps the refund at 5.70 and the 90% full-refund share is not reached (5.67 is 27.4% of 20.66); the full refund comes from POL-RD-06(b). No billing-integrity correction arises: the ledger lines reconcile and no gantry or surcharge line is unmatched. No driver compensation is due — the billed 14.4 km is not less than the traced distance, so POL-RD-04's compensation limb gives nothing. Confidence is 0.90: every artifact deciding the case (EV-GPS-02827, EV-TRIP-02827, EV-FARE-02827, EV-DPROF-02827) carries weight 1.0, and the only zero-weight artifact, the missing advisory, carries no fact. The monetary effect (SGD 20.66) exceeds the POL-GEN-05 automatic execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so the amount is issued but held for release in the human queue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The governing distance is the GPS trace, EV-GPS-02827 (weight_multiplier 1.0): trace_distance_km 14.4 km against the booked optimal of 9.0 km on the trip record, EV-TRIP-02827 (weight 1.0). That is an excess of 5.4 km, 60.0% of optimal, so both POL-RD-01 limbs pass (60.0% > 20% and 5.4 km > 0.8 km) and the 50% materiality gate is also cleared. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 114 fixes at the 10 s interval, 100.0% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0, so POL-RD-07(a)–(c) is not met and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation does not open. Nothing in the bundle excuses the excess, and both sides' own claims say so. EV-CHAT-02827 carries 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable and no waypoint_hint exists for its 200 m test. pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are all null on EV-TRIP-02827, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs. The bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02827-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the driver's counterparty statement 'Road works.' is an assertion citing no evidence ID: under POL-RD-08 it discharges nothing, and under POL-RD-13(2) it neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal. Because the driver named no advisory evidence ID, POL-RD-13(1) keeps this out of POL-RD-10(5) — an assertion citing no artifact cannot be invoked against one — and no escalation trigger fires. POL-RD-02 recomputation, read off EV-FARE-02827: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.0 optimal km + 0.28 x 13.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge, the multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-02827, + 0.80 platform fee, no ERP, no fixed surcharge, no waiting-time fee, no promo discount = 14.99. charged_total = 20.66. Refund = 20.66 - 14.99 = 5.67, rounded up to the nearest 0.05 = 5.70. That is 27.4% of charged_total, above the 0.50 de minimis floor and far below the 90% full-refund share, so POL-RD-02 alone yields PARTIAL_REFUND 5.70. No pass-through line escapes the uplift: tolls_erp is 0.00, airport_surcharge is 0.00, erp_gantries is empty and the ledger reconciles to 20.66, so POL-RD-09 has nothing to settle separately and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity finding arises. The whole contested 20.66 moves. The profile field prior_deviation_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01; both sides mentioned it only to disclaim it, so nothing is built on it and neither claim is discarded on that ground. Both parties: this is a rider-filed dispute over trip TRP-02827, booked as a 9.0 km / 13.0 min RYDE_X trip and driven 14.4 km in 18.8 min, charged SGD 20.66. 1. Deviation established (POL-RD-01). The governing measurement is gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02827 — 14.4 km — against the booked optimal of 9.0 km on EV-TRIP-02827. Excess = 5.4 km, i.e. 60.0% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (60.0% > 20% and 5.4 km > 0.8 km) and the excess clears the 50% materiality gate, so this is a MATERIAL deviation. The trip_record's rounded copy (also 14.4 km) was not used for the threshold. 2. Nothing reduces the excess. EV-CHAT-02827 holds 0 messages, so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 (and no waypoint_hint to run the 200 m test on). Both amendment timestamps and amended_optimal_distance_km/duration are null on EV-TRIP-02827, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run. Vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's explanation, 'Road works.', names no advisory: the bundle's only traffic_advisory, EV-ADVIS-02827-01, is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, BLOCKING), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the traffic assertion carries no weight (POL-RD-08, POL-RD-13). I record that the assertion was discarded and that no advisory was on file for the Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd corridor in this window. This does not escalate: POL-RD-13(1) — the driver named no evidence ID for an advisory, so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. 3. The trace is clean (POL-RD-07). EV-GPS-02827 carries 114 fixes at the 10.0 s expected interval, max gap 0.0 s, 100% coverage, weight 1.0. Limbs (a) to (c) are not met, so the deviation may rest on the trace alone and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route does not open. 4. The POL-RD-02 arithmetic, stated on separate lines as the clause requires: charged_total = 20.66; recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 9.0 km + 0.28 × 13.0 min) × 1.0 surge (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 14.99; refund = 20.66 − 14.99 = 5.67, rounded UP to SGD 5.70. That is 27.4% of charged_total — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and far below the 90% share that triggers a full refund. Taken alone, POL-RD-02 gives a PARTIAL_REFUND of 5.70. The driver's figure on this point is correct. 5. The POL-RD-06 uplift. The driver's claim that the uplift must not be applied is rejected. The pattern test is disjunctive: a pattern is ESTABLISHED when deviation_flags_90d is 3 or more, and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 3. The driver advocate is right that the ratio limb fails (3 / 180 = 0.0167, below 0.05), but that limb is an alternative, not a precondition. Because the deviation is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own trace, POL-RD-06(b) applies. Side by side, so the uplift is auditable: POL-RD-02 figure SGD 5.70; uplifted figure SGD 20.66. No pass-through line is carved out — tolls_erp is 0.00, airport_surcharge is 0.00 and erp_gantries is empty — so the whole charged_total moves. The uplift is a remedy uplift only: the finding of deviation rests on this trip's own trace, not on the driver's history. 6. No billing-integrity correction is due (POL-RD-09). The ledger itemises zero ERP gantries, zero tolls, zero airport surcharge and zero surcharge lines, and its lines reconcile to 20.66, so POL-RD-09(4) is not engaged and adds nothing. 7.
